title: Ratio Reasoning: Convert Measurements within the Same System

items.stem: Which of the following correctly converts 5 feet to inches?
A recipe calls for 3 cups of flour. If 1 cup equals 8 ounces, how many ounces of flour are needed?
Select ALL that apply. Which statements are true when converting from larger to smaller units within the same measurement system?
choices: You multiply to convert from feet to inches.
You divide to convert from inches to feet.
The number of units increases when converting to a smaller unit.
The number of units decreases when converting to a smaller unit.

items.stem: A student wants to convert 4 yards into feet. Explain how they would do this conversion and show your work.
